validity.recommendation: Check which length is right for the Bolsherechenskaya to Tarskaya branch, 94 km or 97 km.
validity.researcher_notes: The branch is real. The 2021 program gives 94 km and the 2021 planning scheme gives 97 km. The newest wiki citation is June 2023, when design was under way. The sheet's own December 2025 ref says the line is in service.

verifications.note: Article of June 2023, read in full. Says design work on the Bolsherechenskaya to Tarskaya branch is under way.
Omsk Oblast planning scheme, edition of June 2021, read in full. 97 km.

fills.researcher_notes: No wiki citation names the owner of this pipeline. The owner on the sheet stays as it is. Not searched this pass.
The wiki citations stop at June 2023, when design was underway. They do not show the line in service. The sheet's own refs from December 2025 were not part of this pass.
The wiki citations give planned dates only. The 2021 Omsk Oblast program lists commissioning in 2025. No wiki citation reports the actual start.

The 2021 Omsk Oblast gas program lists the branch from the Bolsherechenskaya station to the Tarskaya station at 94.00 km. The 2021 planning scheme gives 97 km for the same branch. The sheet value matches the program exactly and stays.

verifications.note: Official Omsk Oblast gazette of 5 February 2021, read as a Wayback copy by hand because the verifier could not reach archive.org. Table row 12 names the branch from Bolsherechenskaya to Tarskaya with length 94.00.

fills.researcher_notes: The Omsk Oblast planning scheme, edition of June 2021, lists the branch from the Bolsherechenskaya station to the Tarskaya station at 97 km with pipe diameter D325, which is 325 mm.

verifications.note: Omsk Oblast planning scheme, edition of June 2021, read in full. Branch from Bolsherechenskaya to Tarskaya, diameter D325, length 97.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The wiki citations show only planning and design up to June 2023. The sheet's own ref of December 2025 reports the line in service and was not re-read this pass. Nothing found changes the status.

cross_row_leads.note: P3981 neighbor: the same 2021 program lists a separate 5.50 km connecting gas pipeline from the Tarskaya station to the existing networks in Tara, planned 2024 to 2025. It may not have its own row on the sheet.

wiki_citations_read.note: Gazprom program page for Omsk Oblast. It lists regional gas projects with done flags and does not name this branch.
Omsk Oblast gazette of February 2021. Table row 12 gives 94.00 km for this branch.
Omsk Oblast planning scheme, June 2021. Gives D325 and 97 km for this branch.
Omsk gas program article of June 2023. Says design of this branch is under way.

summary: "Lean wiki recovery. Length and diameter sourced. Status and start left as recorded."
